text: A single burger, fries, and milkshake cost $16! A bit too steep for repeat visits. The burger was soft and smaller than a whopper. The cringed fries were average. The shake was good. You probably get more value from BK or McD. Sorry , not too impressed with their foods and value!

I love this restaurant the food was delicious and fresh
Our waiter Maria was amazing I will be recommending this place to all my friends  and family 
The manager Zayda as well came and checked in to make sure we were good love that the manager cares about the customers and the service

My favorite pizza in the area is the three cheese pizza from Mannino's - it's a three cheese pizza with ricotta on it, and I absolutely love it. Their other pizzas are also good. I've found their non-pizza food, like nachos, are hit or miss. They're a little pricey but you can order online, which I like. I will probably never stop going there for my ricotta pizza.

Ordered Carry-Out, my first time. Got to the store, handed my debit card, guy at counter says "Cash Only". So they have an ATM right next to the counter so obviously I try it, but it's a $3.00 fee to use. I told the guy all I have is my card, he says "Didn't I tell you on the phone 'Cash only'?" I said "No, you didn't, it's my first time I would have remembered that".They seemed indifferent, so I walked out. I'm sure their food is decent, maybe? I don't know, didn't get to try it, but trust me I won't be forgetting cash next time. Kinda lame to cash only to save on card processing fees.

When they opened in Boise,  it was great .... lately the  tacos have gone done hill  2- Stars . The other night the enchilada's  were cold ! 
I hope they don't get complacent  with  their Quality  .....  or they will Fail  !

My husband and I ordered the fish tacos, fish and chips, and buffalo chicken dip. They were all uneventful.  The fish tacos were dry, and the fish was hard and thin. The fish and chips tasted like processed fish. It reminded me of school lunch back in the days. I've actually had better in the frozen food section at the supermarket. The buffalo chicken dip was bland and tasted like chicken, cheez wiz, and hot sauce. I will not be returning to this restaurant.

I don't usually go out for "fast-food" now days, as it feels unhealthy and heavy. But I needed a quick bite to eat and Pei Wei was near. I decided to swing in and grab some grub. I ordered the ahi-tuna salad and it did not disappoint. The flavors of it were 10/10, the fish was fresh, the raw ginger added a perfect hint of spice. This salad was fresh and healthy, compared to other options available. I highly recommend this meal and this location, as it was clean and the staff was quite friendly. This will definitely be my go-to if nearby and need something tasty to eat.

OMG... What an absolutely phenomenal meal.... I should say after the salad.

I had their seafood rigatoniit was to die for a friend had their seafood special and a couple others had fish and they were all outstanding.  

The main course was so wonderful I forgot about how lousy the salad was.  Seven dollars for some lettuce and a couple pieces of feta cheese, not really a Greek salad.  

Let's get back to the main course incredibly fresh tender loaded with seafood mushrooms, and their scallops on my friends special were out of this world.

Make the salads better and you get five stars.   The waiter was wonderful too.

Stopped by for brunch on Saturday.  Brennan's did not disappoint.  The cocktails were light and fresh.  We started with a French Toast appetizer.  What a melt in your mouth treat!  I then had the steak and eggs and my wife had the Eggs Hussarde.  It was a delicious choice for both of us.  Finished off with the bread pudding which was spectacular.  The service was timely and very helpful with suggestions.  So glad we stopped in before heading back to Dallas.  It was well worth it.

Go for the tacos! Affordable and delicious. Hard shell and flour tortillas taste great. The barbacoa and al pastor meat was really delicious. I'd also recommend getting the guacamole and trying their different salsas. So good!

3.5 stars. My lettuce-wrapped Black & Bleu Burger ($8.29) was large & flavorful. It was cooked perfectly. The bacon was a nice touch, the tomatoes were very good, & the blue cheese dressing was beautifully lumpy. The lettuce wrap was plentiful & fresh. It truly was a very good burger MINUS the overabundance of SALT. I love salt, but when it overshadows other quality ingredients, it's simply too much. (Everything else about the burger was excellent.) 

No sweet potato fries were available (how does a business not keep enough ingredients in stock?), & the $1.99 side of coleslaw was quite bad. I could see nor taste ANY dressing on the cabbage mixture (see pic); it went in the trash. 

The dining room was open, but w/ limited seating. The restaurant was clean, & there was a nice side covered patio w/ tables & chairs. The "Sauce Bar" was not available (see pic); I shall assume it's due to covid fears. 

Parking can be tight; it's a small lot shared w/ other businesses. There's currently no street light at the entrance/exit to Bruce B. Downs, but I've yet to experience difficulty w/ traffic. 

The menu is interesting-- some great sounding burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, & shakes. I found the menu, burger, & prices far more desirable than Five Guys, so I'll eventually return to try something w/ chicken (& hopefully less sodium). 

UPDATE: Days later I returned to this location; I ordered the same burger but made w/ less salt. My burger was perfect! Sadly, the sweet potato fries

Love this place even if your not in Lawrence worth the trip! It's near the state park just down road which would be nice thing to combine if not in area and salt cave over here to :) If not concerned w eating inside books relaxed atmosphere two stories. Only a couple staff working and always wearing masks. The food is all made there not frozen like most chain coffee shops. Even the bread is made there!!! Today I got a cranberry white chocolate scone and wow .... that was worth the calories!!!! The other day had breakfast dfw see attached pic. They also have good salads and sandwiches for lunch and not your typical options. Notice they have French onion soup also right now yum!!! They do also have to go. I do suggest not being in a rush or calling ahead if getting to go does take a few mins if ordering food since made to order not just popped in a microwave. I usually just call ahead and done when I get there in 5 or 10 mins :)

There's nothing exceptional about Joy Garden. It's very similar to every other Chinese-American restaurants in the Treasure Valley serving up greasy, over-salted, super unauthentic food (Panda Garden, Golden Star, Mandarin Palace, etc). That being said, the food isn't bad! Just don't expect anything special. 

I called in an offer for delivery for Combination Dinner No. 1 ($9.05). This included Pork Fried Rice, Mandarin Chicken with Sweet & Sour Sauce, Egg Foo Yong and Fried Shrimp. I was in the mood for a hefty meal so I also included BBQ Pork & Seeds plus Special House Salad ($6.90 for both) to my order. Delivery was speedy for being rush hour. I only waited about 30 minutes and the food arrived still hot! 

The food tasted just like every other Chinese-American restaurant I've tried but I enjoyed every single bite! The fried rice didn't taste like it had made in grease as old as the sun. It was delicious and a lot of flavor. The egg foo yong, while quite unappealing at first glance, tasted great! Again, very flavorful and freshly made. The chicken and shrimp combined well with the sweet and sour sauce. I love these dinners because you can rotate between choices and every bite is different! A bite of chicken, now rice, and salad, back to chicken, it's so much fun especially when it all tastes good!

Overall I would order from Joy Garden again. Yummy food and impressive delivery!

I dont get to stop here much ... I usually love the jj blt but this location was not good... The lady fixing my sandwich complained about the tomatoes but still put the old nasty smooshed tomatoes on my sandwich... She didnt cut all the way though my pickle... Then when inwas standing there waiting for it to be bagged and handed to me she gonna tell me u gotta bag it ur self the bags right there ... So i had to reach over the conter top on my tip toesto get a bag for my order...no napkins ... Yes there was a good by butit was more lile hurry get out so we can go back to doing nothing type tone...  Jimmy johns failed today...

Some of the best Indian food I've had in the University City area. The buffet had a large selection of entrees; my favorites were the Chicken Tikka Masala, Aloo Palak, Chicken Biryani, Vegetable Samosas, and the Tandoori Chicken. Make sure you to try their Kheer (rice pudding) as well! 

The buffet prices are the following: 
Weekday Lunch: $9.99
Weekend and Weekday Dinner: $13.99

Also, note you get 10% off with a student ID. The restaurant is BYOB too.

I was not looking for a Gem when my wife suggested we stop here for a late lunch. In this case, the name doesn't say enough. This establishment was far more than "Courteous". I was pleased with every bite of classic dinner food.

Recommended by the locals here in Franklin. Ordered the combo catfish and quarter chicken breast with mild level spiciness.  The catfish is really really tasty and perfectly seasoned and crispy.  I should have gotten a hotter Le evel chicken I guess to get the full taste.

SOLID PIZZA! 

Be prepared...there will be a wait! Have the right mindset, and just wait - it's worth it.

Super tiny store front, which leaves every square inch of the shop smelling like the fresh ingredients and baked dough.

The 2 guys running the place are hustling the whole time. You can tell their passion pours into the pizza.

Limited options, which was appreciated, just makes it for a quick and direct decision making process. 

If you're lucky, you can order some different varieties, but if you can't, definitely try to get the tomato pie and a regular slice. 

There are some standing tables inside and small seating options outside. 

Music was on point inside, and crazy pizza-oriented art all over the walls. just really cool vibes. 

The pizza itself was really good! Crispy crust, coated with extra olive oil and cheese - so delicious. Those little details just make the whole thing. The sauce and cheese combination play really well together, and the the pie itself is cooked perfectly. Firm, but still enough give to bend in half if that's how you prefer to chow down. 

All in all, really solid spot in Fishtown that I think can be a staple for a long time.

We just love this restaurant. From the staff to Tony to the delicious food it doesn't get any better. Oh and our favorite server Antonio is the best  Our disappointment was that they took the Chicken Rosa off the All the menu items are great but that was my favorite dish to get when I come there.  Hoping they put it back on the menu.

The best subs in town, imo. The service is stellar. Always friendly and happy. The one time they messed up my order, the manager when above and beyond to make it right. Online orders are always there waiting for my pickup, I never have to wait the way I do with other restaurants. Pricey for a sub, but worth it.
Very mediocre food. Terrible service. Used to be a great place to go for a few drinks. Not any more. Closes very early. Covid used as excuse of course.

Burgers galore!! Came here on a Thursday evening and had a lovely time on the patio. 

Our waiter was a character and made our dining experience fun. He had so many jokes and sarcasm. We started with a few beers from their expansive list. Our waiter even offered a few recommendations based on our beer preferences. We started off with the jalapeño poppers which were to die for with the sweet jam. Also great for sharing. 

For dinner I ordered the Yob which is the Gouda burger. My friends got the goatsnake and the pantera. All of them were so delicious. The burger toppings and creations are so unique and creative. Also the burger sizes are enough to feed two people. I only ate half of mine and had leftovers for the next day. We all decided to get different Mac n cheeses as our side which was a small up charge but totally worth it. The size of the Mac n cheese bowl was an entree in itself. You get to pick 2 ingredients to mix in. The waiter recommended chicken and caramelized onions which was a perfect combo. Everyone had leftovers of that too and left sooo full. 

I will definitely be coming back to try some of their other burger concoctions.

Cute casual spot just off Mandalay. Order at the window and pick up when your number is called. Lots of outdoor seating. Had the fish tacos and Cuban and both were great. Generous portions, very tasty and reasonably priced. Lots of stuff to try on the menu, will be back for sure.

After ordering from my go-to's over and over again, I was in the mood to try a new sushi place for delivery and have Qu Japan a shot based on other positive reviews. I am truly blown away by how delicious and high quality their sushi is! You can taste (and honestly, see!) the freshness. I felt like everything was reasonably priced (the lunch specials look like a steal- I'll definitely be trying those) and it was packaged together perfectly for delivery. I'm so excited to have found a new place and will definitely be ordering again!

This place is amazing. The outdoor seating is nice. When I went there the first time I got mussels which were to die for and the Cassarecce pasta. Can I say amazing! The hazelnut gelato was a fantastic treat. The second time I came I got the calamari. Great! The scallops were amazing

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience at the Project! The food and drinks were great! The service was awesome! We will definitely tell friends about this Restaurant! Next time we are in town we will come back!

Love this place, good workers, really nice, great food, what else could you ask for???  You can get any flavor profile in a taco, bowl, burrito, etc.  from day 1 I had a favorite and I make sure to come by weekly and I can't commit to anything!!
This place is awesome!!!! Had the meatball sub,, and it was delicious  I would recommend this place for some yummmmy food!!!

First time at Luigi's. Bought Sicilian calamari in sauce with olive, capers and garlic slivers. It was a generous portion. Calamari was tender, capers plump and sauce fairly thick and well seasoned. Would definitely buy again. Leftovers will go on pasta. Pizza was Brooklyn with Kennett mushrooms. Liked the crust. Tasty and just chewy enough. Topping was fine. Could have used more mushrooms. Satisfied enough to return.

I ordered their vegan burger. It was not the best, but it wasn't bad and I appreciate the option. Their fries on the other hand are amazing. I ordered golden potatoes curly fries. They weren't very curly or crunchy but the flavor was good. Also got red potatoes fries which I thought were golden potatoes due to the appearance but the taste was different. The real prize was the purple potato po'balls. PERFECTION. It comes with a good amount for the price and every bite is savory and amazing. Don't pass up on them!

They were busy when we walked in and now I know why. They have plenty of menu options, a cute family diner vibe and the service was great. Love that they have mimosas every day for $3.99. Ordered the Breakfast Pie and the Bissell Breakfast. Both were very good, although the potatoes inside the breakfast pie were pretty undercooked, the rest of it was good enough to just eat around them. Reasonably priced for the portion sizes. Overheard a few of the servers interact with customers who seemed to be regulars which was refreshing and speaks to their staff and the service for sure. Will have to come back and try the Fried Chicken and Waffle- we saw that dish go by us a few times and it looked amazing.

The older woman answering the phones on Sept 18th was awful. She had terrible customer service. Talking at you with an attitude. Not sure if she was having a bad day but she need not take it out on all of your customers. I watched her give attitude to several tables, people on the phone, and us. 

As for the food. The Birria was OK. There was no side of consume. Also they didn't have goat. It was beef. The pork belly quesedilla was awful. Not sure if it wasn't cooked right but man did it have a funky taste. Like fry the pork belly. Don't just serve it all gelatin like. The chicken taco al pastor was probably the best thing.

In all, not sure if this is a new place or what but they didn't have it together. The food was underwhelming. It looked better in yelp.

First time here was for a business lunch and can't wait to bring the family back. First off, loved the decor of the place and all the plants and trees inside, which gave you the feeling of eating outdoors. We started off with the cheese plate as an appetizer, which was amazing, and then for lunch, I went with the French toast, which was very good. Service was pretty good throughout and like how they offer contactless payment. Will definitely be back in the near future.

Amazing food. One of the best cocktails I have ever had:  shoutout to all the pears....bourbon, pears. Can't go wrong. I had the fish and chips. Delish, although for me the chips were a bit salty. The tater tots with cheese sauce....the bomb. I will def be coming back when I am in town again.
Service and food was outstanding. Fried pickles and Greek lamb burger were both just amazing. Tomato salad was also very delicious. Place was very clean.

Ok so first off, I will only write negative reviews when I have a really, really bad experience. I've come to Bailey's Range a bunch of times since they first opened, and I think the service has really gone downhill. We came in for lunch with a group of 8 and had a couple hours to eat and then get to a meeting. We were ready to order quickly but a server didn't show up until about a half hour after we were seated. The server seemed pretty apathetic and was obviously in no rush at all. We ordered drinks, then 20 minutes later, the waiter came back to take our food order and said the drinks would be right out... but they still didn't show up for another 20 minutes. So that's about an hour after being seated that we even received drinks. The food came out after about a half hour in a pretty empty restaurant. They messed up my order - I'm vegetarian and repeated my non-complicated order twice (no bacon and a veggie patty? not hard to remember) but my burger still came out with bacon on it. Half of the food was barely warm, my burger bun seemed stale, and it was definitely the worst burger I've had at Range.  Just overall a pretty bad experience.

We are always delighted with the food and service here. It's a wonderful little restaurant that takes pride in the food they serve. You will get chef quality dishes that you would expect to pay more for, the prices and quality are excellent !! Love the specials !!

I went there two days in a roll. The original milk tea is good. I like the red dragon as well but the milk tea is a bit too pale to my liking. I will try to order that with original milk tea. We also tried honey black tea and mango green tea with various flavored jelly. Overall I will recommend the drinks here especially when they get the customization right (amount of sugar and ice). I will return here again.
Folks were super nice and the service was  good. If you like fried foods then this is the place for you. Not much option for those who would like healthier options.

Its a close and local option for well priced tacos and burritos. I've also had the fusion choice of the Azul Fries which is every taco topping piled high on French fried. (That's healthy right? Lol)
It is in the parking lot of the Shell gas station but that shouldn't deter you. The prices are fair and the owner is very nice. The food is also great quality and tastes good. 
Overall it's a nice quick option for Mexican food if you don't want to go to the chain places like Tijuana Flats or Chipotle.

We ate the buffet today and what a freaking joke!!! First, we had to make reservations, ok...that's fine. Made them 5 days ago. We used to eat here all the time before COVID. Last time was in Feb for my birthday. For 2 people with a senior discount it was $43. Today for 2 people it was $87. They doubled the prices and did away with the discount. We would have walked away, but we went there for our anniversary a few days early. AND....half the food stations were closed and there was half the amount of food to choose from!!! We were in total shock!!! And what food there was, was COLD!!! If you've been there before you know they had a huge dessert selection. Well....they had ice cream, donuts and cookies!!! Never, ever again will we go again!!!!

This place is so much fun to dine in and enjoy line dancing and live bands. We visited when things were normal and had a terrific time. Can't wait to visit again. Portions are big, drinks are strong and priced right! The salad bar is awesome!

The food here is absolutely phenomenal! From creamy baba ghanoush to savory Chicken shawarma, Aroma has no shortage of options to choose from. My fiancée Nikki and I have come several times with our friends and each time has been better than the last. The flavors are authentic and truly a refreshing experience. 

The staff are extremely polite and attentive as well. It's rare to find places where the staff are just as amazing as the food. We can't help but recommend our server Bassal, he has been a delight from day 1 and ensures all our individual preferences are accounted for. He has built a rapport with his customers which is evident through flawless execution and top not service.

Simply put, Aroma consistently satisfies all of our cravings and is hands down the best Mediterranean cuisine in the area. We recently moved from New Jersey and I can confidently say, we've found a new hot spot that we will recommend to all our friends. 

Enjoy!

I have been a loyal customer for years. For a long time, I used to come in the morning, order my cup of Joe and my favorite cookies; the signature cookies( I drool thinking about it), read my book and just chill. I also cane with my family to eat their amazing pizzas, or just enjoy basically great food. Few days ago I wanted to cook up something and needed bread for the recipe... I  called them up and to my surprise they were open for business. Of course operation is different these days so you can order and pay on the phone, and when you pick it up, you will be greeted with one of the employees at the door. Also they have few tables outside where you can order and eat their delicious food. I was impressed with how seriously they are taking the new rules at this time. 

P.S there is plenty of parking outside. And make sure to check their hours ( in the past they were only open half day on Sunday and were closed on Monday).

Wow! Great food and service. We had Harvest Brandy Burgers. Scrumptious--best burgers around!!! Burgers had sautéed onions, lettuce, tomato, and brandy sauce. So good! It comes with delicious fries or salad. Both were excellent. Service was great and we will be back with friends.

Went last night and omg, was awesome.  Ordered a spread(hummus pin intended).  Ate in a mini greenhouse and brought our personal hand warming heaters but didn't really need them. 

Our server Daniel was great.  He made the night awesome.  We will be back regularly to this gem of a place.  

Full disclosure, Indo across the street and Nixta are two of our favorites and we are regulars at each.  Omg, btw, calling the chicken meatballs, chicken meatballs seems so cruel.  They were the best thing I've eaten.  Omg, I can taste them as I write this!!!

This place is fantastic! Food is affordable and really great. The owner and service is unbelievable. The owner came up and gave us a dessert and an extra smoothie on the house. He also told us a little bit about his life. We will definitely be back!
Great bar with great music! We had Brandon as a server and he was great. Definitely recommend.

I had a great date night experience here with my girlfriend, especially since we were able to sit outside. This is a great place to take a date and enjoy the outside environment as you eat some delicious, Italian food. There is a giant mural on the building next to the restaurant that depicts the Italian countryside that the founders of the restaurant were descendants of, so it adds a nice touch of culture and art of the patio vibes. They also have an herb garden where spices and garnishes are picked as the dishes are being made, giving the food a more authentic feeling. They also had live music playing which added a nice touch of entertain to an already memorable experience. 

The food was delicious, but some plates were small, so I would suggest Le Virtu if you're looking for an experience and not just a meal to fill you up. With that said, the salami and cheese boards are a good starter and the wine list is reasonably priced

Cheers!

The sweet pototos, and collards Greens was good but I could not eat the Macaroni and cheese it just did not appeal to me The veggie lasagna did not appeal to me and the cheese cake was ok 
I did a postmate to try you out  sorry but needs improvements on those items at least what I had today ! It was a $40 order

Come here for your next Sunday brunch! My husband and I enjoyed stopping in to Lincoln's for brunch and were delighted at the service, food, and price. Although the place was busy, we were seated quick and offered coffee and water. 

We were both starving so decided on our orders quick despite the lengthy menu. I chose the Veggie Scrambler with a side of pancakes and was not disappointed. The portions were good, the food was delicious, and the cost was appropriate too! 

Now, let me just mention how delicious the pancakes were. I typically do not get pancakes but, since it was a "pancake house" I simply had to. Guys, they were SO good! They were hot, fluffy, and topped with a slab of butter. (I mean, aren't you drooling just looking at the picture?!) I didn't put a single drop of syrup on them they were that good! 

I will most certainly be back!

Well, well, well...a new restaurant in Rittenhouse area and let me tell you something one of their dishes blew me away. 

Shrimp Siu Mai - $12 for eight extremely well portioned Shrimp with a Pea on top, thats right a Pea. I mean it works!! I believe this is defined as one of the Cantonese big three staple items and my god it blew me away like no other. Please if you are a fan of Shrimp get this item ASAP!!

Beef-Stuffed Scallion Pancakes - Three servings of this dish and it is quite good. Fried all be it but different and not bad. My one qualm is no sauces were given to me in my entire order but I am assuming was by mistake you can't deliver these two items without sauces and expect to get five stars???

Shanghai Wonton Soup - $8.00 wonton soup. I knew I was getting ripped off when I ordered this but really wanted soup. DO NOT GET THIS. You will be disappointed. Not even good, was a very big let down but I think the restaurant knows what its doing and making a great profit on people that really want soup as this is the cheapest verison of wonton soup they offer.

Eggplant Garlic Sauce - I literally own a mug that says give me eggplant or give me death so one of the things I can do is critique eggplant dishes. This dish has a wonderful amount of spice, not too much but bordering on too much spice for the casual diner. I really enjoyed this dish but it was not great when reheated.

Based all my first experience here I would defintely be up for a visit once the COVID-19 Pandemi

I ordered the Monte Cristo  with a side of hash browns. Expect to be stuffed because it is such a huge serving. I think this is perfect to share. We also ordered the Hawaiian Breakfast, Loco Moco, and the Meat Lover's omelette. Each dish was delicious and very filling. We loved the Portuguese sausage. My sister said the macaroni salad alone was good but needed a little bit of seasoning if it was eaten by itself. However, it was perfect to balance out the saltiness of the sausage and spam. Each dish was so good. I also had grapefruit juice which was tart and refreshing.

After looking at the reviews and appreciating Pi Pizzeria was within walking distance of my hotel I decided to go there for dinner (before the dinner crowd might arrive). The greeter asked me if I wanted a booth or table and I told him I was fine with either so he pointed to the bar. While sitting there I saw customers at the tables finish their meals, others being served, and even people who arrived after me receiving menus and ordering. I was never given a menu or approached by any of the 3 employees working behind the bar, even though I was just sitting there waiting. After over 10 minutes of being ignored, I left the bar and told the greeter I was not pleased with service.  His only response was to ask me how long I had been sitting there. The restaurant was not even busy. Because of their lack of customer service, I will not go there again. There are too many good restaurants in the area to settle for one in which you feel invisible. Can I give zero stars?

I'm pretty obsessed with Morgan's Pier. This is the perfect place to chill with your friends, grab awesome food/drinks and see a gorgeous view of the water/bridge. 

They are very strict with their policies during COVID as they should be. The bouncer tells you the list of rules before you enter and you must have a reservation. At first, we were placed at a table with a gorgeous view, but unfortunately, no umbrella. Our waitress quickly corrected this for us, which was much appreciated. 

For food, everything was EXCELLENT. The chicken wings, meatballs and calamari were all tasty. The fat breads were INSANE. As someone from NJ/NY, I was hesitant to even order but I'm so glad I did. Both the Margherita and Roast Pork fat bread knocked it out of the park. Insanely good. Our friends got the lobster rolls and said they were "ok" - nothing special but decent. The fries were very good. 

For a wonderful, relaxing and impressive view, definitely head to Morgan's Pier!

Visited the terminal Market and was sampling all the good Eats! We stopped fiirst at Becks Canjun Cafe it was delightful. The gumbo was awesome the service was great. I even bought the devil's dust. Definitely recommend if you love cajun.

Yummy fresh no frills sushi. This isn't Sagami or anything but for the price point and it being a fast food type of place, it's surprisingly decent. Eel cucumber roll was excellent. Spicy tuna was not bad. It came with a free side salad for their lunch special. I would order again

On my last trip to NOLA I saved Napoleon House for my last day, because I know that if I didn't it would have been like my last trip and i would have been in there three days in a row. The best jambalaya I've had down in New Orleans by far. I'm not a fan of olives, but the muffalettas are amazing. You cannot leave without a Pimms Cup either! Such a beautiful place I recommend eating in the courtyard at least once, then saving yourself in the air conditioning. My favorite restaurant for sure.

Good Greek food, but I've had better. I think the thing that ruined it for us was that it smelled a bit like a wet dishrag in there. They need to figure out what that odor is and get rid of it, pronto. That's a bad first impression.

My favorite spot to stop in and get pizza.  My pizza maker at 4pm, today was A-M-A-Z-I-N-G.  The shift lead or Manager Adam was A-M-A-Z-I-N-G, and I got to eat in peace and relax before heading into the hospital.  Thanks!
I love their egg tarts, and Japanese cheesecake is a must. Love it so close to USF that I don't need to travel far between classes to get some good snack

Well, our bill just arrived for a hockey puck of a burger and some cold stale fries with a plastic cup half full of wine.  They did take the burger and fries off my bill once I insisted. The manager couldn't make it to our dirty table and suggested to our waiter that they comp the wine rather than replacing or refunding the bad meals. Great location right on the water with good music but way overpriced and the service and food are sub-par.  Don't bother.  The food reminds me of overpriced, prepackaged, first frozen, amusement park food.  Might be ok for drinks if you have an attentive waiter/reds or just sit at the bar. These locals are not impressed and will not be back.

The pizza was pretty good. I like how you can choose a full pizza or just do a half. The staff was very friendly and ready to help. They really loaded up on the toppings too which was great and there are a lot of options.

During this lifetime I could never have imagined living the life I do. In my life I have experienced #trauma around food with being  #neglected #malnourished and #hungry 

During my thirties I began my #healing around #food In my forties I decided to go #vegan and introduce my body to foods I have never had like normal #veggies and #fruit it has been an amazing journey!

Thank you to my friend in #florida for providing the meals on my trip. My favorite so far has been this #rawvegan cold #cornchowder soup @ciderpresscafe 

This soup is made from #corn #cashew buttercream #coconut #picodegallo 

#foodporn #foodstagram #foodasmedicine #tuesdaymotivation #vegans #plantbased #plantbaseddiet  #reno #getinmybelly #yoga #mindfuleating
Love the place. GREAT Cuban Sandwich and the croquettes yummy. And the best cafe con leche I had in a long time. Abd the service awesome. Nice good people. Definitively will visit again.

They offer indoor and outdoor seating. It's an exotic indoor ambiance, but such a cute place to "escape" your everyday life. Their menu is in a different language. I ordered the Moule Frites which was absolutely amazing.  Probably one of the best mussels I've had. It came with French fries which were also very good. The mussels were so soft and not chewy at all. The dessert was good, not amazing, but had a good display. You're looking at $10+ for a plate here and offer an extensive drink/bottle menu.

I've been hearing about the Full Belly Deli for so long, just had to try it. 
Perhaps they were off today - but my Dirka Dirka had very little meat on one side and a moderate amount on the other. For the $ they charge, you really should get a full serving of meat. The flavors were good - just odd composition. 

HD had a chicken sammie that was coated in breading? Seemed a bit too bready for me. 

I'll give it another try - maybe not during lunch time rush - but I won't hurry back.

Absolutely the best Pho in the Nashville area. I drive from Hendersonville frequently dine there or for take-out. The broth is delicious and provide a lot of meats and toppings for the price. I have tried all to Vietnamese restaurants in the area and this one is by far the best.

This place was great after a long drive this place definitely hit the spot . We got 805 and island beer , strawberry shake , the trio ( fries, sweet potato fries and super yummy onion rings . Padaro burger , country club and the tri tip sandwich. Will definitely come here again .

Kitchen is understaffed and lights are WAY too bright and I have the background to opine on this.  You seriously need someone to come in and do something, anything with your lights. I've worked with other fast casual national chains, fast food and fine dining establishments and can tell you you're really hurting your sales by having your bar area interrogation levels of bright.   It's not just bright you also have a glare problem.

Food is as should be expected for a Beefs.  Not terrible, not knocking any socks off.  

Service is spotty depending on who's there and how busy your bartender is managing take out.

What a mess! Went through the drive through for a relatively simple order - 6 assorted donuts and 3 were just original glazed. I had to repeat my order not once, not twice, not thrice - but FOUR times! 

The lady on the speaker kept going back and forth with taking my order and handling a customer call on the phone. Don't try to multi-task that one - it clearly isn't your strong suit. The whole reason I know she was on a call is she left the speaker on. I thought it was me she was yelling at to download an app. 

She suddenly disappeared and someone more competent took over and got my order correctly. Pulled up to the window and got my order after a while. Donuts were strangely smaller than normal. 

Everything tasted fine, but the drive thru service could be much, much better.

My first dining out experience since covid 19. Ventured out for sushi on the patio at the CWE location. I was disappointed but I understood that happy hour prices were not offered at this time. We had to go inside to the hostess stand to have our temp taken and then back outside to be seated on the patio. Seemed like a lot of unnecessary door touching. No physical menus but by scanning a QR code we were able to access the menu and pay electronically. Then the waitress brought the food to our table. She checked on us as far water went but otherwise we were left to ourself. Definitely felt safe and germ free. A little lonely tho... :( 

Ok but food: edamame hummus is 10/10 would recommend you won't be disappointed. We got the starburst and spider rolls. If you like pink soy paper, starburst is the way to go! 

Same excellent quality food as always and now with upgraded safety measures!

It could be that I'm starting to think all brunch menus feel the same these days but the food was good. The jam was just the right amount of sweetness and I enjoyed it the most. The presentation of the hash was cool and tall. My friend said the actual taste was amazing but couldn't finish it. The farmhouse eggs come with a salad with a vinegarette dressing which was a weird pairing to me. It felt more decorative that meshing of amazing tastes. This place has great service and if you are a brunch foodie it's definitely a place to check off your list.

I love The Loading Dock at Fort Houston, but it took me awhile to check this location out. First time  i went I had the best breakfast burrito I've ever had. The coffee is great and and so is the vibe. Second time I had the Super Avocado Toast - perfect balance of hummus, tomatoes, greens and flavorful avocados with a sweet balsamic drizzled on top. Great addition to the neighborhood!

The first time I came here, I had recently returned from a couple of weeks in Athens, eating fresh food, well prepared. I try not to compare, but we always have a perspective, don't we?  The mediocre Greek restaurant a couple of blocks from my home had changed hands and was now marginally better and way too expensive for the quality. 

Yiro Yiro, on the other hand, does not disappoint.  The food is delicious Greek street food, the servings abundant, and the prices good. 

I don't live in the area, but try to stop in whenever I'm near.

I'm calling this cheesesteak 'Great Adventure' because it was a roller coaster of emotion.  I saw the roll and thought I was going to not like this cheesesteak.  I smelled the mushrooms and thought I might like this cheesesteak.  My first bitre was a touch dry and I thought I might not like this cheesesteak.  I took my second bite and really liked the flavor of the meat.  More cheese, a better roll and I love this cheesesteak.
Inside a bit sterile, doubt we'd eat in ever. However, they offer great made to order breakfast sandwiches which is difficult to find nearby.
It's a little chilly out here, but it feels great to be out doors again dinning out. I hope they continue to stay open and everyone stay safe

Decent spot for dinner later towards the night. Street parking and they have a yelp wait list to help manage your spot in line. 

Food hit the spot, would recommend if you're in the area.

$15 for a very greasy burger and fries...and no napkin :-( Brisket burger tasted good, but was pretty sloppy. Fries had some sort of green herb on them, unique flavor. 10 minutes to cook the burger and then it sat under the hot lamp for 5 more minutes before being served. Probably won't come back for the Smash menu.

Everyone was super friendly but cashier wasn't knowledgeable.  I got the general Tso's chicken which was good; however, the broccoli was not tasty and certainly frozen.  The Pepsi machines where Great!  Overall it was better then a Panda Express but wasn't Amazing!

LOVED ... LOVED ... LOVED The Strawberry Shortcake !!!  it was really yummie !!!  I took my dadthere for a snack and we got an appetizer, which was the margarita flat bread ... then ordered the dessert.  Jeff was our waiter and he was AWESOME !!!  He was helpful, attentive and very pleasant.  When we go back we shall ask for him.  You maybe should consider having the Strawberry shortcake be on the menu every strawberry season.  I for one and also my dad will be back for it if I see it offered again.  As I stated above ... we specifically came for it and loved it.  Thank you again ...
Ordered and picked up curbside a large vegetarian stromboli with fresh garlic the other day. Excellent. Getting hungry just thinking about it. Pizza is always good here....fried raviolis too.

Love the atmosphere. It's a favorite for any out of towners I bring there; they always want to go back. Lately I feel like the drinks are served in smaller cups and the portions have been smaller. They used to serve 3 tacos, but a few weeks ago my boyfriend only got 2 with his meal. The sweet potato fries have also been served in smaller baskets. Still would recommend.
From out of town, stopped here and was a little worried about the menu but took a risk on the Richie rich, it was fantastic. Great cocktails too.

Ordered to go during Covid-19 era. Kids apples were inedible, burgers we ordered were good. Fries loose their luster rather quickly "to-go". Service was ok bringing it to my vehicle. Not sure why they expect a tip for a to-go order
I had the Cheesesteak and it was delicious.  I also ordered the Yuca Fries and it taste great.  Support your local sandwich shop!!

Finally ordered the family meal. It was everything I had hoped for. Food was fresh, portions were big enough to share although my teenagers ate the entire portion and then some. It was easy to place the order ahead of time and curbside pickup was hassle free. I highly recommend these dinner deals any night of the week.
So many choices!  I would have never thought of making chicken salad with ranch dressing but it was very tasty

Ok , the beer was the best I have had in a brewery a long time. Their German style beers we're the best I have had outside of Germany. Food was amazing, wait staff was excellent and super friendly Aaro attentive. Highly recommend this place. Will return when my travels  take me back to the Reno area.

We've been here a couple times and the experience was overall not great. The service is always on the low side of mediocre. The staff was unfriendly and inattentive. Our food took close to an hour both times we've been here and there were literally less than ten people in the restaurant. After waiting for an hour for our food part of it wasn't right but couldn't get a word in before our server turned away and walked off. She did apologize afterward. The prices and portion sizes are good but overall this place is nothing extraordinary.

Best place to eat near the Tucson airport! Friendly, efficient service. The best huevos rancheros I have ever experienced. In the future, I will always schedule time to eat there, flying into or out of Tucson.
Nice breakfast spot in South Tampa.  On the small side so expect a wait.  Well worth it though.

As I was in the area and very hungry, I noticed this place to eat. I walked in and a very friendly hostess greeted me as I looked up at the menu board. I wasn't sure what to order at all but I chose the turkey slices entrée. I took the food to go . They have several sides to choose from so I chose the coleslaw so delicious, and the mac & cheese. Both those sides were above average in quality. They had a small bit of barbecue sauce that went with the meal that had  very nice flavor.Plenty of turkey slices so I gave them to my husband for his lunch when I got home!

Came across this place here on Yelp typed in Fish and grits near by this spot came up,, never even knew this place was here, I drive pass all the time.. but yea the food was actually good will return, fast service also a plus

I'm obsessed with this place! Went here for my birthday the past few years and for an early Valentine's Day this year as well. Amazing food quality, decent portions. You have to try the cheese boards, they're excellent and the cheese mongers are so good at what they do. Price wise, Talula's compares to most other upscale restaurants in the city...we got one cocktail each, a cheese board, a side of brussel sprouts (highly recommend) to share and two entrees for $175 with tip.
Everything is well explained to you...the service is excellent/well trained on the details of the menus and they take any allergy or food aversion seriously. But I advise everyone to go here at least once...it'll change your perspective on any place else!

*Disclaimer: yes, you will sit close to the people next to you. It is a smaller space with a large number of people trying to get a reservation. It has never taken away from my dining experience if I have good company and good food!

We were soooo lucky to get a table on Saturday without reservation, although it was early. I love their Foie Gras and potato pave. It seems they change the fruit with Foie Gras frequent and today is strawberry jam with rhubarb. I had high expectation for urchin, the combination of yogurt and scrambled egg was perfect, but unfortunately, the urchin was too big and tastes bitter. I'd suggest ppl to ask if urchin is fresh or small before ordering. Then, if you want something innovative, please order that marrow bone agnolotti!

So I've been to Culver's before and really like the cheese curds and love their custard. Today being Friday and for lent ordered their North Atlantic Cod sandwich. I really wanted to like it but it was so bland and no flavor at all. Huge disappointment!!

I received a coupon in the mail for my birthday. It provided a free $15 entrée with the purchase of another entrée. I consider that generous and invited my cousin to meet me there for lunch. I ordered the lunch, 4 ounce, fillet mignon. Small but delicious and cooked Medium as ordered, but  could have  been a little pinker inside. It was tender and I enjoyed it. I have to add, the plate was not presented "attractively". It had my small steak and french fries on it, very dull, but nothing decorative like a tomato slice or anything to make it look special. My cousin ordered a hamburger that did not get served quite as ordered, but that situation was quickly remedied. She said it was one of the best  hamburgers she had ever eaten!  Our waiter was pleasant and we enjoyed him.  I very much appreciated the free $15 towards our meal, although a very small serving of ice cream or a small dessert of some kind would have been a nice addition. This Houlihan's is located in Creve Coeur and since it was chilly outside we did not take advantage of the outdoor patio which is one of my favorites

What a fun, but busy place.  Our daughter, who lives in NOLA, recommended this place as we were visiting from out-of-state.  Our server was very helpful and friendly.  My spouse had a hard time deciding on a cocktail when looking at the menu, so she encouraged him to just name what he wanted if he didn't see it listed, and he did, and she indicated that it's a full bar, and they would make it.  And, thanks to her they did.  Our cocktails and food were awesome.  It does get crowded at lunch time, but we were we lucky and didn't have to wait.

This is my favorite Chinese Buffet in town.  The service is excellent and the food is Always fresh and soo good!  
  My entire family, from my grandchildren to my 93 year old father, WW2 Veteran, love their food.
  They are using Covid 19 restrictions.  
   Ate there yesterday and felt like things were finally getting back to normal!!

Called in an order for 2 green chili chimichangas last night and asked for red sauce instead of green.  They took my name and number and said it would be ready for pickup in 15 - 20 minutes and hung up.  I had looked at the online menu prior to ordering and expected the chimis to be $9.99.  When I picked up my order they said it was $30.39!  I said " for two chimichangas with rice and beans?" They said that the green chimis were now $10.99 and there was a $5.49 upcharge for the red sauce!  I said that should have been explained to me on the phone.  Bottom line is, there should never be an upcharge for basically substituting red sauce for the green. Who does that?  Nobody!  Also, they need to update their online menu if prices change.  They never offered to remove the upcharge from the bill for the misunderstanding, and finally, you always advise the customer of any upcharges and tell them the total over the phone before hanging up.  I have been a long time patron of this restaurant and I told them...they just lost a customer.  Poor customer service...sad to say.  30 BUCKS FOR TWO CHIMIS...REALLY...
This place was awesome. We went on a Monday evening. Quick service. Amazing pizza (get the mushroom). Friendly staff. A must try!

It's been a long time since we've ordered takeout from this restaurant. Maybe two years even!! But the nice thing is that it is still owned by the same family. The same young lady that takes your order when you call still has the same no nonsense, unfriendly tone. 
However, the food is consistently good! Delivery is always timely and they are always friendly!! ( They have even delivered our order to the backyard while we were in the hot tub!! Lol!!).I would have given five stars but I only found 4 tiny shrimp in my large order of House Special fried rice.

Lobby bar on the 2nd for is well with a visit. Hosted by the lovely Sonia, their octopus appetizer was most delicious. Will return the next time we have a hankering for Greek food, as their menu includes ask of my favorites and it's much closer than Tarpon Springs for us locals!

We love Lilly's Tacos. These are killer tacos, they remind me of "LAST". (LA Street Tacos) a SoCal tradition for many moons. The line up outside Lilly's is the proof in the salsa. BTW killer traditional salsa choices top of the killer old school tacos. Great salsa flavors for your Active Salsa Requirements or ASR.

Not fancy, a simple straight shooter taco business.

Lilly's does a great job on catering for large office parties. Check your orders really well when ordering for really large groups. They deliver a killer taco party to order as you love'm. Plenty of food to get down with these bad boys. The tortillas are really lovely. The selection of meats is way cool for meat lovers. Veggie choices too!

Love'n Lilly's About Now.  Lilly's is fairly fast and real friendly. They do get real busy, cool old fashion taco hang out. Enjoy. 8~{

It seems like there are more Pizza places in town now than ever before. Nearly every corner has one and the delivery apps are full of them. But try as I might I couldn't find a GOOD pizza place. 

Under cooked soggy pizza is now the norm it seems, so imagine my surprise when I tried Pitza Pizza and they delivered a perfectly executed pie that would have given Giuseppe's in Amber PA a run for their money. 

Pizza is easy to find, but really good pizza is just so difficult to come by these days. Easy 5 stars for an amazing gem of a restaurant. If you haven't done so, give Pitza Pizza a try, they "get it". Our new favorite place for a slice of great pizza. 

Pitza Pizza is a small mom and pop place that needs our support, and I for one am happy to give it to them.

Hi I would like to say I used to like getting food from here . This is my first review I don't like giving reviews unless they're real good. But tonight was it the last we will ever eat here . They will always forget a item with your order like the tortillas that come with the fajitas that I usually order but I stop getting them because they don't give the tortillas like come with them ( drive back and bitch or heat  some up at home but that not take out) and or the side chips that we order and call about there mistake it's even on the receipt and they were telling us it's our fault and then they hang up. But it gets better after my wife calls sits back down to finish up the food that they put stuff when we ask not for it and it's also on the receipt. I take a bite of my chicken loaded nachos define a long 12 inch hair in my food threw up at the table in front of in the whole family then they throughout their entire meal. Very disgusting the health department should be informed. Definitely do not eat here or take out or delivery go to another taco place they're all the same.  Never again we used to get take once a week since they open in Flourtown . F--king disgusting hair in the food
Excellent atmosphere. Quite lively. Interesting that the age range of guests was all over (kids to older adults). Nice, friendly space but nothing too crazy for nightlife.

I had a wonderful experience with this location. The cashier Pat was very cheerful and helpful which made my experience a pleasant one. My food was very tasty and was made very quickly. I ordered pick up and the food was ready when I got there(10 min). Overall, they have great staff, food, prices, and service. I will definitely be coming back in the future.

First visit there yesterday and it was very good!  We eat out every night and have been  frequenting the other Asian places in town regularly - this one, so far is going to be up towards the top.  Quick, friendly service - nice and clean.  Good sized portions with great flavors!

Came here on a Friday evening. The wait for our chicken was about 15-20 minutes. There's a few bar seats by the window (first come). Complimentary water available. Drinks for sale too. We got chicken thighs, drumsticks by the piece and tenders. The cornbread came with an amazing honey butter! The chicken was made well, juicy. There's a light drizzle of honey on the chicken; could definitely use more- you can buy different sauces on the side. 

Good service. 
Clean. 
Street parking.

Great food at a great price. Tasty and good quality seafood. I had fried scallops and fried shrimp with sweet potato fries. Comfortable atmosphere too. Good size platters for what you pay for. Will definitely be coming back again.

We didn't have a reservation but were able to grab a high top at the bar in under 10 minutes. The service was great and so was the food. We shared the yellowfin tuna tar tar which was amazing. I ordered the soft shell crab and my husband had fish. We both really enjoyed it but the best part was the biscuits.

Just went for the first time. Reservations a must  if you want to go on a weekend. We got sat within 5 minutes of arriving. Place was clean,  nice ambience and friendly staff. We ordered drinks, an appetizer and main course all at once. Drinks came out in good time. Food took awhile. First the appetizer of clams casino. They were tasty but SO TINY. that was disappointing. I mean the clams were, no lie, the size of a quarter with two the size of a half dollar. I got the meatball parmigiana sandwich and my gf got linguini with meatballs. The sweet potato fries were perfect. Even the side of coleslaw was really good. And food came out hot. But again took awhile. 

So all in all a good place. I would definitely go back. Only two draw backs were size of clams and time it took the food to come out.

Decided to grab a late brunch with the hubby. Boy were we surprised when we took a look at the buffet and saw fresh crisp tortillas and an assortment of accoutrements to make taco salads tacos tortillas or anything you could do think of. 

Our waiter Alejandro was attentive, and quick. Never once did any of our drinks go empty. 

We will be returning again and again to our favorite Mexican restaurant.

This was my first time ever going to the Rainforest Cafe, so I was very excited; however, the food was really bland. I got the Anaconda Pasta, and there was barely any pasta just vegetables. The workers were very kind, and I loved the atmosphere of the place though.

I picked up a couple of meals yesterday for the first time while I was out getting something at my Veterinarian. Totally convenient and I have always wanted to try this place. There was a friendly regular that was picking up an order that I asked what his go to meal was. He was quick to say "The Crack Bowl!" I took his advice and ordered the chicken crack bowl and also the daily which happened to be tri tip. The crack bowl is going to be my new favorite. It has chicken, kale, nuts, tomato, and quinoa. I may have forgot some things. It is a great combo and so satisfying. 
The Tri tip was great too! It had roasted veggies, potatoes, onions. Tatziki  on top again I may be forgetting some things. Still delish but I'm hooked on the crack bowls for sure!
I also got a dessert for my Mom. A Strawberry Shortcake! She thoroughly enjoyed it! All the desserts looked delicious! I will be back for sure!

The food was fantastic. The wait was very acceptable. Everything fell short on the service. One burger came undercooked. Usually not a problem, but it was for my child. Secondly, my drink disappeared half way through my meal. I went to refresh after a particularly spicy bite, and my drink was gone! To be clear, I had only finished half of my drink. I assume the server intended to top me off, but it never happened. Overall, a solid 3 out of 5. Would be happy to return to give it another shot.
Eh, food i a little overrated to be honest. Its not bad but really nothing special unfortunately.
Food was good, chicken stew, but cold, even after I asked for it to be warmed.  But I did it all.  Other plate, lamb shank per my friend,  delicious. Will come back.

Love this place

I get great sushi and my dad gets a sandwich 

Great quality sushi at a reasonable price

Wonderful food and service!!! We ate at Salty's our first night of vacation and had such delicious food and service we returned 2 more times!! Thank you ! Mary was our awesome waitress!! We highly recommend Salty's and Mary!!!

Okay yes it's authentic it's okay I mean depends who you get as a waiter, almost need a translator 'but I will say it's tasty Chinese food it's not the greatest' one person $31 for two it's okay- house chow mein with beef sweet and sour pork - egg rolls-
Inside needs a facelift for sure'

No words to explain the food and service. Fabulous and amazing don't come close. Thank you Koree for amazing suggestions on food and Lindsey for the delicious cocktails. First time in Idaho and can't ask for a better meal to start the trip.

For the record, I normally don't eat hot dogs, but they catered a party I was at and I have to say, Dave can make an awesome hot dog!!! Yumm!!! The Santa Barbara dog is awesome! Also, he's a super nice local dude! So bring him your bus
100% the best happy hour in Reno it's upstairs on the second floor food is incredible the atmosphere is even better and the drinks are delicious service has always been top notch

Used to be my go to place , but tonight I ordered to my job usually same great service, but you didn't send silverware to a business?? And whomever made this chicked Alfredo with broccoli, mistaked the order for chicken and noodles in buttery water.  Worst Alfredo I've ever had. Here's a pic. I can't even eat it. Send fb message with pics no response.

Checked out a new breakfast place this morning and boy did we enjoy it! We arrived on a Sunday morning around 9am and the place was packed. We had about a 10 minute wait and the nice thing was that they provided free self-serve coffee while you waited.  We were seated within the wait time given and our waitress quickly came over to greet us and take our drink orders. So many delicious sounding items on the menu but my wife went with the Farmhouse Hash while I went with the Floridian French Toast. My two boys had pancakes (one Lemon Ricotta and the other chocolate chip). We should have ordered off the kids menu for our littler one as the regular size pancakes cover an entire plate and there's two of them. Everything was so fresh and delicious but it was a lot of food. I was done eating for the day after this meal. We also got their million dollar bacon which I could have eaten all day!! They provided a carafe of coffee at our table so we could easily refill our coffee whenever we wanted. Both of my boys enjoyed their hot chocolate with whip cream and my wife also got the Morning Meditation Fresh Juice, which was a concoction of orange, lemon, ginger, beet, and agave nectar. Very refreshing!! Overall, we really enjoyed our breakfast here but it was definitely a pricey breakfast. For the four of us with tip, we hit the $100 mark. I would like to see smaller portion sizes with smaller prices to go along with that. We will definitely be back, but given the prices, it's not a place

I'm not sure what the hype is on this place. Ordered the all you can eat to go special, which is a good deal. However, the food was sub par at best. The Seafood Yakiton was dry and flavorless plus the wrapping was so thick it was tough to eat, the muscles were overcooked and inedible.  All of the rolls had some type of heavy sauce on them and they were all spicy even though there is nothing about them on their website stating they are spicy, and since I am super sensitive to spice I couldn't eat much of them. Plus side the Nigiri was good. Honestly the worse sushi I've had in Reno and it was a waste of money for sure. Maybe it was just an off day, but they really should have disclaimers online stating that there is a sauce on them and they are spicy.

this place has the worst costumer service I've ever been to, it's like they get paid to have the worst attitude ever. I've been here twice- the first time was when they first had opened and I promised to never go back after the way we were treated. Last night I went back, because I was invited by a friend and AGAIN we were treated so poorly. Do not waste your time in coming here.. there as so many better places around where you could get better service and better snacks! don't waste your time people!

Every time I've been the food has been really good. The employees are also nice. I would definitely go again.  It seems kinda pricey but, only because it's cafeteria style. To me, that makes it feel like it should be cheaper?

The bouncers verbally and physically abuse women in this establishment and they get away with it. Why are there several reviews describing abusive behavior by bouncers towards women, and yet NOTHING is done about it? Do not support this business in any way.

We just moved to St. Pete's from NJ.  My brother and sister-in-law got us a gift card here (who also live back in NJ) for our first dinner in our new home. First the decor, great! Super clean, not over the top, great all around vibe. The staff, awesome! Super friendly and helpful. And now what people really want to know, the food, Killer!!!! We ordered 9 tacos all awesome! Great flavor, the sauces they make are great with them too. The habanero honey is great! The chorizo taco was probably my favorite but they were all really good. This will be a regular local spot for us. We'll be back a lot.

SERVICE GOT HORRIBLE!!! We we're greeted and seated fast. The table where we sat at is a horrible place to put a four seat table. No walk way room and I kept getting elbow by the damn waiter and customer and you have to deal with looking at people ass who sat at the bar(1 feet away), very uncomfortable  when eating sushi and people's ass is literally in your face. Always had to flag the waiter. We were observing the waiter as she ignored our table and went to everyone else to see how they were doing. Didn't want to give us another ordering sheet and always had to ask for one or to get a refill of water. Food took forever to get to us. Sushi chef there didn't know how to make nigiri sushi. My nigiri kept separating from the rice as i try to dip it in soy sauce, fish tasted bad and horrible. My advice to the waiter who income is base on tips, treat every customer the same and not try to give the best service to the people who you would think will tip big. Will not RECOMMEND to family or friends.

Gave 5 stars based on Chef Lisa's Signature Drunken Noodle. I've had the pleasure of traveling around the tri-states areas, and it's real hard to find a truly delicious Drunken Noodle. While traveling through the Chrisriana DE area, I had a hankering for some Beef Drunken Noodle, and came upon this gem. Chef Lisa's Signature Drunken Noodle was a Grand Slam! I also like my Thai food Thai Hot, and it was spot-on with just enough fire, but extinguished in short-order allowing the delicate balanced tastes to come full force! Loved it! Great job Saap Lao, I'll be back for sure, don't change a thing with that dish!

Had the bacon chicken avocado sandwich which was a first for me. It was pretty good and tasted fresh. The Caesar salad was reaaaally good!  They were very liberal with the croutons, mozzarella and Parmesan cheese indeed. The staff was very friendly, professional and quick. I'd def recommend to check out this location.
During Covid, I've tried as many different pizza places in the area as I could. This is my favorite place. The only place that uses fresh toppings.

I traveled to Nashville last week and was so happy to find The Palm located few doors down from my hotel  ( the Hilton Downtown). 
Although I covered a lot of ground while in Nashville,   I kept going back to The Palm Nashville. I sat at the bar  and the bartenders were the best! So professional, personable and kind. 
Honorable mention and shout out to Sami and Grit! 
They made my whole experience and stay so much better!  I ordered a burger  on one of my visits  it was the best burger I have ever had!  Do urself and ur tastebuds a favor & stop in here when u visit. U definitely won't be sorry.
